description: Self-hosted CI/CD and task automation for trusted teams with Jenkins Core feature parity

dashboard.authentication: Bearer token kept only in browser memory or initial admin password setup unlock
accessibility: streaming terminal controls and log copy
declarative YAML/JSON task definition with templates and syntax validation
YAML export with 1-click clipboard copy and file download
first-run setup wizard and initial admin password unlocking

api.execution: Queue only; explicit embedded_worker option for development
api.authorization: Project scopes checked on definitions, runs, logs, artifacts, and deployment requests
api.user_management: Admin-controlled user provisioning with role hierarchy (admin, operator, viewer), project scoping, token generation, rotation, and revocation
api.declarative_yaml_endpoints: POST /api/jobs/yaml, GET /api/jobs/{id}/yaml, POST /api/pipelines/yaml, GET /api/pipelines/{id}/yaml, POST /api/tasks/apply, and POST /api/tasks/validate
api.remote_api_tree_filtering: Supports Jenkins-compatible ?tree= selector across /api/jobs and /api/runs endpoints
api.freestyle_endpoints: Copy (POST /api/jobs/{id}/copy), Rename (POST /api/jobs/{id}/rename), Workspace Explorer (GET /api/jobs/{id}/workspace), Workspace File (GET /api/jobs/{id}/workspace/file), Workspace Wipe (POST /api/jobs/{id}/workspace/wipe), Permalinks (GET /api/jobs/{id}/permalinks/{name}), Permalink Artifacts (GET /api/jobs/{id}/permalinks/{name}/artifacts/{path}), and Retention Run (POST /api/jobs/{id}/retention/run)
api.fingerprints: GET /api/fingerprints/{hash} and POST /api/fingerprints/track for cross-job artifact lineage
api.tools: GET, POST, DELETE /api/tools for global tool installations

capabilities: Automatic task kind detection (standalone job vs multi-step DAG pipeline)
Sensitive webhook secret redaction on export

invariants: Terminal state and notification queued in one transaction
Atomic sequential build numbering per job
Setup completion and admin credential state tracking
Artifact fingerprint registry tracking MD5 and SHA-256 digests
storage.migration: Version 1 initialization/guard plus read-only idempotent legacy import; incremental schema migrations pending

responsibilities: Artifact integrity and glob archiving with exclusions
MD5 and SHA-256 artifact fingerprint recording
Downstream build triggering on completion threshold
LogRotator automated build and log retention
Standard CI/CD environment variables and runtime parameter injection
worker.concurrency: Per-worker concurrent runs, per-job concurrency mutex (concurrent_builds), and per-pipeline parallel steps
worker.retry: Standalone jobs persist availability/attempts and release slots; pipeline steps retry within live pipeline execution
worker.recovery: Expired running leases become lost; no automatic side-effect replay

executors.docker: Structured CLI, no network, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, resource limits, workspace mount, forced cleanup
executors.python: Separate isolated-interpreter subprocess; trusted host opt-in
executors.http: Exact hostname allowlist, bounded response, no redirects or ambient proxies
executors.process_cleanup: Unix process groups; Windows Job Objects

triggers.cron: Standard 5/6 field cron and Jenkins H-notation (H/15 * * * *, H(0-29)/10 * * * *, H H(0-7) * * *) seeded deterministically by job ID
triggers.github: HMAC-verified push payloads, repository/branch allowlist, body deduplication, public repository exact-commit checkout
triggers.webhook: Hashed shared secret, idempotency key, active webhook definition required
triggers.downstream: Triggered by upstream completed jobs on SUCCESS, UNSTABLE, or ALWAYS with upstream cause lineage

artifacts.access: Authenticated project-scoped API and permalink paths
artifacts.preview: Authenticated text preview up to 256KB for logs, manifests, and reports
artifacts.fingerprints: MD5 and SHA-256 fingerprint tracking across jobs and runs
artifacts.retention: LogRotator automatic retention (max builds and max age days) protecting keep_forever flags and permalinks

deployments.approval: Different administrator identity by default; bound to image digest and target configuration
deployments.provenance: Matching checksum-verified release.json from successful source run
deployments.serialization: Environment lock; failed/cancelled/lost deployment retained until explicit admin reconciliation
deployments.stale_builds: Reject older source creation time unless admin requests rollback
deployments.docker: Pull before stopping existing container; backup rename; candidate health check; restoration on failure
deployments.kubernetes: Set configured Deployment container image; rollout verification; previous-image restoration on failure
limitations: Build provenance trusts authorized build authors

observability.metrics: GET /metrics authenticated admin; persisted status gauges and online worker count
observability.notifications: HTTP endpoint; transactional outbox work, five delivery attempts, idempotency key
observability.cli: taskforge build, console, and artifacts commands for direct terminal observability

deployment.api_image: docker/Dockerfile non-root image with dashboard package data
deployment.compose: docker/docker-compose.yml API + worker + PostgreSQL + shared artifact volume with .env and POSTGRES_PASSWORD fallback configuration
worker_prerequisites: Tools for selected executors: git, Docker, kubectl as needed
deployment.default_image_tools: Python only; provision specialized workers for Git/Docker/Kubernetes

ci.production_deploy: Requires configured real target and separate approval

known_limits: Dynamic database tokens, setup password auth, and static config tokens supported; OIDC/SSO federated identity pending
Local shared artifacts with automated LogRotator retention; external object store (S3/GCS) pending
No private repository authentication or GitHub commit status reporting
Definition lists capped at 500; scheduler scans 10000
No aggregate project resource quota or worker capability routing
Dependency version ranges, no pinned dependency lock
Kubernetes verified with simulated commands until a real staging cluster is supplied
